reviewer: Codex source adjudication for founder-requested GameStop batch recovery
adjudication: Contemporaneous PokeBeach report explicitly names a Reverse Holo GameStop Charmander. Independent Fanatics physical slab photograph shows the red GameStop stamp,MEW004/165,70HP and large Fire Energy geometric reverse pattern across the text body; no Cosmos circles/stars. This resolves the conflicting later Bulbapedia Cosmos Parallel and TCGdex-derived Normal labels in favor of Reverse. Fanatics title incorrectly says Sword & Shield; photographed MEW label and card establish exact set.
source_independence: pokebeach_original_release_report and TCGplayer catalogue/image. TCGCSV and TCGplayer image count as one family.
